nodes.description: Privileged owner address of BotProtected; set in constructor from msg.sender and gates delegate() and list().
External Ferrum Launch Protection contract address used as the target of a low-level call inside the checkBots modifier.
Address of the Uniswap pair passed into the bot protection call for pair-based bot filtering.
Constructor storing the bot protection contract address supplied at deployment.
Modifier that performs an external low-level call to botProtection before executing the guarded function body.
Low-level botProtection.call(...) with raw selector 0x15274141; unchecked return data and untrusted external callee executed before state updates.
Caller-controlled address used for owner assignment, allowance checks, approve bookkeeping and access control comparisons.
Miner-influenced timestamp used to build the Uniswap addLiquidityETH deadline (block.timestamp + 600).
Public mapping of token balances; mutated in transferFrom and list without safety checks.
Public nested mapping of allowances; written in constructor and approve, decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
Constant token decimals set to 18.
Public total supply constant used in the list() distribution math.
Token name string 'Gen Shards'.
Token symbol string 'GS'.
UniswapV2Router02 instance used for liquidity provision in list().
WETH address used for computing the Uniswap pair in the constructor.
Constructor setting owner, computing uniPair and granting infinite allowances to the router and msg.sender.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable guarded transferFrom that mutates allowance and balance mappings without SafeMath.
Public payable approve that unconditionally overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to an externally supplied address with arbitrary calldata.
Internal pure helper deriving the Uniswap pair address from two token addresses.
Owner-only listing function that overwrites balances, calls addLiquidityETH with ETH and loops distributing tokens to arbitrary recipients.
a.delegatecall(b) with attacker-controllable target and calldata; return value ignored and full contract storage can be hijacked.
External payable call to uniRouter.addLiquidityETH forwarding msg.value, executed after balance writes and before the distribution loop.
Unchecked subtraction of allowance and balances plus unchecked addition to recipient balance (Solidity 0.7, no SafeMath).
Unchecked multiplication and division totalSupply * 6 / 100 used to size the msg.sender balance.
Source address parameter of transferFrom, forwarded to the bot check and debited from balanceOf/allowance.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom, credited in balanceOf.
Transfer amount parameter of transferFrom used in unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic.
Amount parameter of list() assigned directly into balanceOf and passed to addLiquidityETH.
Recipient address array distributed in the list() loop.
Amount array assigned to the corresponding recipients in the list() loop.
Arbitrary target address of the delegatecall in delegate().
Arbitrary calldata bytes forwarded to the delegatecall in delegate().
Boolean local holding the raw success flag of the low-level bot protection call, asserted with require.
Unused bytes local holding the returndata of the low-level bot protection call.
Deployment-time address stored into the botProtection state variable.

edges.reason: Deployer address msg.sender is the only source of the privileged botProtection constructor argument context.
Constructor parameter _botProtection is stored into the botProtection state variable.
GenShards constructor invokes pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair.
wETH state variable is passed as tokenB into pairFor.
Constructor writes the pairFor result into uniPair.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender, establishing privileged access for later owner-only functions.
transfer() forwards all arguments to the internal call transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom is guarded by the checkBots modifier, which executes an external call before the body.
botProtection state variable is the target of the low-level call.
checkBots modifier performs the raw botProtection.call with selector 0x15274141.
uniPair state variable is encoded into the bot protection call arguments.
_from parameter is forwarded into the bot protection check.
_to parameter is forwarded into the bot protection check.
_value parameter is forwarded into the bot protection check.
Untrusted external call in the checkBots modifier runs before the guarded transferFrom body updates balances and allowances.
msg.sender is compared against _from to decide whether an allowance spend is required in transferFrom.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is read as the spender authorization check in transferFrom.
balanceOf[_from] is read as the balance sufficiency check in transferFrom.
balanceOf mapping entries are mutated with unchecked subtraction and addition in transferFrom.
allowance mapping entry is decremented with unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
transferFrom body directly performs the unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller-controlled address as owner.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner, the only access control on the arbitrary delegatecall.
owner state variable is the comparison target of the require in delegate().
Parameter a supplies the target address of the delegatecall.
Parameter b supplies the calldata of the delegatecall.
delegate() executes the unsafe delegatecall instruction.
_numList parameter is assigned into balanceOf and passed to addLiquidityETH.
_tos array parameter drives the distribution loop in list().
_amounts array parameter supplies the balances assigned in the distribution loop.
list() requires msg.sender == owner before mutating supply and balances.
owner state variable is the comparison target of the require in list().
list() invokes uniRouter.addLiquidityETH with value msg.value.
uniRouter state variable is the external contract invoked by the liquidity call.
block.timestamp + 600 is supplied as the deadline, making the liquidity call timestamp dependent.
External payable call to the router occurs while list() has already rewritten balances, enabling reentrant state access before the distribution loop completes.
list() computes balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply * 6 / 100 with unchecked arithmetic.
totalSupply state variable feeds the unchecked multiplication and division.
list() unconditionally overwrites balanceOf entries for address(this), msg.sender and arbitrary recipients.
pairFor returns the computed pair address which becomes uniPair.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _from only carries the source address into transferFrom and its bot check, so it is folded into that function node.
Parameter _to is only used as the credit recipient inside transferFrom and is merged into the function node.
Parameter _value is the operand of the unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic and merges into that unsafe operation.
Parameter _numList is only consumed by list() to seed balances and the liquidity call, so it collapses into list.
Parameter _tos merely drives the distribution loop inside list() and is folded into the function node.
Parameter _amounts only supplies loop values inside list() and merges into the function node.
Parameter a is solely the target address of the unsafe delegatecall and merges into that unsafe operation.
Parameter b is solely the calldata of the unsafe delegatecall and merges into that unsafe operation.
Local notABot only holds the require-asserted success flag of the modifier's low-level call and merges into checkBots.
Local isNotBot stores the unused returndata of the low-level call and merges into that unsafe operation.
Constructor parameter _botProtection is immediately stored into state and merges into the constructor node.
